## What changed

Describe the user-facing result and the smallest set of implementation changes.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm run sw:generate` was run after runtime changes.
- [ ] `npm run validate` passes locally, or the missing check is explained below.
- [ ] Desktop and phone layouts affected by this change were inspected.
- [ ] Offline behavior was checked if app-shell, routing, or curriculum files changed.
- [ ] Curriculum baseline changes are intentional and reviewed.
- [ ] No backend, tracking, external runtime asset, or unnecessary dependency was added.

## Data compatibility

Describe any effect on local progress, imports/exports, stable opening or line IDs, and recovery behavior. Write “None” when there is no effect.
